snippet.title: HELLO, NEIGHBOR - Curse Retold // Teaser Trailer (Hello Neighbor 1 Mod) // Early Footage
snippet.description:
--------
IMPORTANT NOTE
The voiceline for this cutscene used in the trailer was created before AI became a real threat to artists (Early 2023) and we found out it was AI only recently. We changed it as soon as we could in Early Access v0.5.3. We wish we could've done so sooner, but the audio was merged and we didn't have much time to rework the whole thing back then.
Fatal Peek Team does NOT support AI. The individual who attempted to join us while pretending to be a voice actress and singer was removed from the team as soon as we were made aware of the situation and before anything was kept for the full release. We'll be keeping said individual's identity a secret as we are against witch-hunting and don't want this person to be misunderstood since they didn't know how serious of a mistake this was back in the day.
A huge thank you to everyone who pointed this out, and our heartfelt apologies to real artists for the inconvenience.
--------

We sadly have to cut short and won't have time for mods, but before we go we will launch the mod we put the most effort into in the last couple months.

Introducing "Curse Retold", a complete Reboot of a mid-effort experimental mod we made a few years ago called "Alphas Relocked".

Mod will feature a completely revamped story based on the official lore of Mr. Peterson, while introducing tons of newer, older, and custom mechanics.

This will replace Alphas Relocked's ModDB Page at launch day.
The mod will hopefully release soon.

Download Link: https://www.moddb.com/mods/hello-neighbor-curse-retold/downloads/curse-retold-official

-----------------------
#HelloNeighbor #Modding #Reboot
